notes: Splat Suite 1.21.1 - a project only uses its own data, and the farm never installs half a dataset. An independent review found that 1.21.0 could build one project's dataset from another project's solve, train another project's dataset and record the result in the open one, carry clips from one project into the next, and, when a farm job was stopped part-way, install half a dataset over a good one and call it done. All of that is fixed: every run reads the open project's own record, another project's data is refused, and a project can't be switched while a local run is writing into it. A node now packs its dataset under a temporary name, and this PC places one only from a finished job with every model file and the exact image count the node built. Archiving a previous result is a rename, retried for antivirus, so nothing is deleted to make room. RealityScan exports keep 'Exclude unreliable tie points' on by default and bound the point cloud to twenty times the camera rig. Also: Studio is never launched twice, and the console shows red only when something went wrong. Install on EVERY machine - the fixes that protect your data live on the PC that sends the job.
